submissions.title: Texas will audit up to 300 projects, mostly data centers, after Gov. Greg Abbott's order
submissions.excerpt: about 250 to 300 projects, most of which are data centers
submissions.note: SITING RESTRICTION: Following Gov. Abbott's Aug 3, 2026 directive to PUCT/ERCOT to audit all data center projects in the interconnection queue before any new ones are approved ('Any project that fails to comply...must be denied connection to the Texas grid'), this Aug 14 follow-up reports the audit's scope: roughly 250-300 projects, most of them data centers, statewide. This is a state-level connection pause, not a local moratorium, and could affect grid-dependent phases of several Texas projects already tracked here (Stargate Milam County, Stargate Wisconsin, Stargate Shackelford County, Abilene Clean Campus, Aligned Caprock, Cipher Black Pearl, Crusoe Goodnight, Fluidstack Abernathy, IREN Childress/Sweetwater, QTS-Lancium Hall County, CyrusOne Freestone) to the extent they still need new/expanded ERCOT interconnection — none of those project entries currently reflect this. Not yet in tracker as a restriction. LIMITATION: WebFetch to external sites was blocked this session; quote reconstructed from search summary, verify against the source before use.
